# Browser Automation Studio rehabilitation

- Destination: runtime lines <= 205000
- Budget: 72h
- Acceptance intent: BAS is fast, reliable, polished, maintainable and
  production ready: each concept has one owner; all 24 preservation journeys
  exist and pass daily on Linux x64; recordings are faithful and reviewable in
  the intended player; BAS builds and runs on macOS. Daily qualification and
  quality bands are in the status scoreboard.
- Non-goals: Commercial launch, billing and publication are out of scope. No
  Swarm Manager, no Plan Manager plan. No git; the operator commits.
- Design: plan artifact
  `epoch-based-delivery-orchestration-and-bas-rehabilitation/source/TARGET_MODEL.md`.
